name: Quantum Club RVCE
description:
Anoraniya is the official Quantum Technology Club at RV College of Engineering. It serves as a dynamic platform for students to explore the frontiers of quantum mechanics, quantum computing, and advanced quantum technologies beyond the conventional academic curriculum. By promoting critical thinking, innovation, and a research-centric approach, the club empowers students with the skills and tools necessary to address contemporary challenges in physics and computational sciences.

With a vision to inspire and nurture the next generation of quantum scientists and engineers, Anoraniya fosters an intellectually stimulating environment that emphasizes academic curiosity, collaborative learning, and interdisciplinary engagement. The club regularly organizes seminars, technical workshops, research discussions, and expert lectures delivered by distinguished professionals in the field.
Through these initiatives, Anoraniya cultivates a culture rooted in scientific inquiry and technical excellence, contributing to the global momentum in quantum research and innovation.


Key Milestones
●	Development and implementation of BB84 Quantum Key Distribution Protocol
●	Tabletop setup for Spontaneous Parametric Down-Conversion (SPDC)
●	Low-cost micron scale photolithography setup by students
●	Setup and deployment of Michelson and Mach-Zehnder Interferometers
●	Crystal Growth using SR method
●	Crystal Growth using Bridgman method
●	DFT simulations for nanoporous Graphene based gas sensors 

We Aim to

events.name: Technical showcase
events.detail: An interactive showcase of innovative student projects, working prototypes, research initiatives, and technical achievements. Participants will get an opportunity to explore real engineering and scientific applications through demonstrations, exhibits, and discussions with the teams behind the projects. The showcase will highlight interdisciplinary work across quantum technology, electronics, robotics, materials science, AI, and scientific instrumentation.

events.name: Interactive Science & Quantum Experiment
events.detail: A hands-on science and quantum experience designed to make complex scientific concepts engaging and accessible. Participants will take part in thought experiments, scientific riddles, interactive demonstrations, and hands-on challenges exploring the fascinating possibilities of the quantum world. Participants will earn points through challenges and compete on a leaderboard, encouraging curiosity, problem-solving, and scientific thinking.

events.name: Laser Communication Challenge
events.detail: An interactive optical communication challenge where participants use a laser-based communication system to transmit and decode messages. Inspired by Morse code, participants will learn how information can be encoded into light signals and attempt to decode hidden messages using an optical communication setup. The activity combines physics, communication technology, and problem-solving in a fun competitive format.

events.name: Escape Quantum Lab
events.detail: A 30-minute immersive scientific escape-room challenge. An experiment in the Quantum Lab has gone wrong, and participants must work as a team to restore the system and unlock the final solution before time runs out. Teams will solve a series of scientific puzzles, decode clues, perform experimental challenges, and apply concepts from physics and quantum science to progress through the lab. The activity combines teamwork, logical reasoning, experimentation, and time-based problem-solving.
